semantics.selection: After NULL-state/outside-view and higher-priority checkpoint/receptacle dispatch, role bit5 selects bank1 and descriptor X bias8; otherwise bank0 and bias16. semantics.frame_clock: Add phase_step to phase BYTE modulo256. The resulting bit7 triggers frame advancement; addition carry is not tested. Nonnegative results are stored as phase; negative results reset phase then increment BYTE frame index modulo256 before unsigned count comparison.
